description: Cost any recipe from its ingredients. For each ingredient give the pack price, the pack size and the quantity used (same unit as the pack size, e.g. grams). Returns each line cost, batch cost, cost per portion and a suggested menu price from a target food cost % (default 30%), ex-VAT and inc-VAT. open_in_prepsheet_url opens this exact recipe in the free PrepSheet tool (no sign-in), where the user can edit, scale, print and save it; the recipe travels in the link itself and is not stored by PrepSheet.

pack_price.description: Price paid for the whole pack, ex-VAT.

pack_size.description: Size of the pack, e.g. 2000 for a 2 kg bag in grams.

quantity_used.description: Amount used in this recipe, in the same unit as pack_size.

unit.description: Optional unit label, e.g. g, ml, each.

portions.description: How many portions the batch makes.

target_food_cost_pct.description: Target food cost as % of the ex-VAT price. Default 30.

vat_rate_pct.description: VAT rate for the inc-VAT price. Default 20 (UK standard).

name: cost_recipe
title: Cost a recipe
